text: 1) BoltOdds: on GitHub its snapshot call is refused with 429 (limit is 6/min per IP address; runners share addresses, or the daily quota). I changed the engine to retry in 60 s instead of 5 min and to log the exact 429 reason; engine is restarting on that now. If it still 429s I'll know why from the log. 2) Wake-up: the chat watcher already costs zero model tokens while a session is open. It can't start a session that doesn't exist; only a Claude routine can. Options: (a) a routine you create on claude.ai with an API trigger that the app fires when you send a message (each message then starts a session; costs usage per message) or (b) leave as is: an open session answers within ~6 s, otherwise the next routine (3 a day) does. Tell me if you want (a); you'd create the routine, I'd wire the app. 3) Bid pause: analysis: the 18 bid fills so far average +2.7% EV against the blended fair, but against the sharp book 5 of the last 8 were slightly below price. Resting bids naturally fill when the line moves against them, 8 fills is too few to be sure, and SGO (the sharp book) was dead during those fills. So a stop isn't needed for long: I cut the pause from 3 h to 1 h and the guard now judges only fills from the last 8 h, needing 6 NEW fills to trip again. Bids resume with the engine restart now.
